summary: FBS Global Ltd, a Cayman Islands company listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K containing a notice of an extraordinary general meeting and proxy statement. The sole proposed resolution is a 10-for-1 share consolidation, reducing authorized shares from 500,000,000 to 50,000,000 at US$0.01 par value, contingent on Nasdaq clearance. The record date is September 2, 2026, and the meeting is set for September 13, 2026. The board recommends the proposal. This is a routine corporate action to maintain listing standards, not a special situation. Watch for Nasdaq approval and exact share count post-consolidation.
